facts.fact: A meeting chaired by the minister of state on 2026-09-20 was attended by the head of the General Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty, and by the head of the National Authority for Information Security and Safety, both stated as existing national bodies; the meeting discussed drawing up an integrated national cybersecurity plan.
